Create new account

Do you already have an XMPP account? This might be the case if you are already using a different XMPP client or have used Conversations before. If not you can create a new XMPP account right now.\nHint: Some email providers also provide XMPP accounts.

XMPP is a provider-independent instant messaging network. You can use this app with whichever XMPP server you choose.\nHowever, for your convenience we made it easy to create an account on conversations.im; a provider specifically suited for use with Conversations.

MAER paid messaging service

Maer Chat is free software. Access to the messaging infrastructure operated for MAER requires an active paid account supplied by MAER Engineering. Pricing, duration, renewal, termination, support and the operator’s legal details are those stated in the commercial offer or contract provided to the customer; those contractual documents prevail.
Service usage conditions

Keep your credentials confidential, protect your devices and use the service lawfully without abuse, spam or interference. Account activation, suspension and termination are managed by the server under the applicable commercial contract. The GPL rights in the software are not withdrawn if access to the MAER service ends.
Privacy and security

The application processes locally the account identifier, contacts you choose, messages, media, profile pictures, cryptographic material and connection diagnostics needed for messaging. The configured XMPP and upload services process the data required to route and store communications. TLS protects transport. End-to-end encryption applies only when the conversation explicitly shows OMEMO encryption. Retention, recipients, support contacts and exercise of privacy rights are specified by the MAER service contract and privacy notice.

Payment concerns the MAER service, not permission to exercise GPL rights. Third-party components keep their own licenses and notices.
Source code and provenance

The corresponding Maer Chat source, build instructions, GPL text and notices are published at https://github.com/jeff-net52/MaerChat. Conversations remains credited as the upstream project; MAER Engineering and the upstream project do not endorse one another.
Names and trademarks

The GPL covers copyright permissions in the software. It does not grant a general right to present a modified service as an official MAER service. MAER Chat is independent from WhatsApp; familiar messaging patterns do not imply affiliation and no WhatsApp asset is included.
